name: recurrence-scope
title: Recurrence Scope
description: This one / This and following / All picker for recurring events that reads back the dates each choice changes, with counts and past dates called out, and warns by date and field before overwriting occurrences that were edited on their own.

meta.stops: Edited whole series instead of one
meta.summary: Reduces edits that hit more of a recurring series than intended by listing exactly which dates each scope choice changes.
catches: Exactly which occurrences each scope touches, with a count
Past occurrences included in the change
Occurrences with their own edits that would be overwritten, by date and field
A repeat-rule change, which regenerates (and overwrites) the whole affected range
Option to keep individually edited occurrences
limits: Works on the occurrences you pass in; it does not expand RRULEs itself
Does not save anything; onConfirm receives the choice
a11y: Scope options are a radiogroup labelled by the title, built from labelled radio inputs
Changed dates list has an aria-label; changed/kept/unchanged state shown as text, not colour alone
Count and overwrite warning render in polite live regions
Save disables while pending, with an aria-hidden spinner
